methods_quotes.q: Pearson’s chi-square and Fisher’s exact tests were performed to examine associations between demographic characteristics and responses to TB questions.
For significant chi-square associations, post-hoc calculations of adjusted standardized residuals were performed.
Bonferroni corrections were applied to chi-square p-values and adjusted standardized residual critical values to reduce the likelihood of type I error
